test.title: Something you are saving money to buy

document.cue: Describe something you are saving money to buy.

text: At the moment I'm saving up for a good laptop, one that's powerful enough for video editing. I started about eight months ago, and if everything goes to plan, I should have enough by the end of the winter.

I've already got about two-thirds of the money. Most of it comes from a part-time job at a language centre, where I help with admin three evenings a week, and the rest is birthday money from relatives, which I've managed not to spend for once.

To be honest, saving hasn't been easy. I set up a separate account in my banking app and transfer a fixed amount there every payday, so the money disappears before I can think about it. I've also cut down on eating out and taxis, which was painful at first, especially in January when it was minus twenty-five.

The reason I want it so much is that I've started making short videos for a small online business run by a friend. My current laptop is six years old and freezes every time I try to export a file, so it's actually holding me back. A better one would let me take on more work and, hopefully, pay for itself.
So for me it's not really a luxury — it's more of an investment.

tips.en: Transfer a fixed amount … every payday describes a concrete saving system.
tips.kk: Transfer a fixed amount … every payday — ақша жинаудың нақты жүйесі.
tips.ru: Transfer a fixed amount … every payday — конкретная система экономии.
tips.example: transfer a fixed amount there every payday

tips.en: Not really a luxury but an investment is a memorable conclusion.
